# Open Alpha2

> UBTECH Alpha2 local HTTP+WebSocket API, port 8888, complete mapping of 17 AIDL calls, with MCP tools.

## Docs
- OpenAPI: /openapi.yml
- Docs UI: /docs/
- AsyncAPI: /asyncapi.yml
- MCP sync: /openapi/mcp-openapi-sync.yml (repo openapi/)

## Use
- Control panel: http://{robotIp}:8888/
- Typed JS: window.Alpha2Api.servoOne({id,angle,time}) (api-client.js)
- Validation: ApiValidator.java (server), assertEnum/assertRange (client)
